about: MUSIC-LIKE-01: rows for the make_band tool (bench_row band-tool). label B = a song reference with a plain ask to make a band like it (make_band expected); N = anything else, music-related or not (make_band must not be called). The song reference is the maipai://music/track/<id> link the Band like this button sends. Persona names only.
